description: Independent Parkside catalog: models, IAN codes, companies, specifications and documented provenance.
heroText: The independent Parkside tool catalog. Models, specifications and companies in one place, with the sources always within reach.
manifesto: Find the IAN code on the product label, packaging or manual.
search: Search by model, IAN, tool or company…
filterNote: Search by model or IAN and combine filters to narrow the results.
emptyText: Try another model or remove a filter.
privateRepo: The catalog is public: you can propose corrections on GitHub.
footer: Models, manuals and specifications for Parkside products.
trademark: Not affiliated with Lidl or PARKSIDE. All referenced trademarks belong to their respective owners.
illustrations: Photos belong to their respective owners; original icons appear when a photo is unavailable.
methodTitle: The source comes before the label.
methodLead: Parkside Atlas collects Parkside products and checks information about the companies involved.
ianText: IAN (International Article Number) is the article number Lidl uses to identify a product and find its manuals, support and spare parts. It differs from the model name, the individual unit’s serial number and the EAN barcode.
missingText: No manufacturer attribution based on appearance, color or forum rumors. Power supplies and categories derived from catalog titles are editorial classifications; specifications need explicit documentation.
contributeText: Choose a product and suggest a missing detail or correction. Translations are optional.
methodLegal: PARKSIDE and Lidl are trademarks of their respective owners. This project is not affiliated with, sponsored by or approved by Lidl. The names identify the products in the catalog. The Parkside Atlas logo and illustrations are original.
translationNote: The linked original documents remain the reference for declarations and safety instructions.
companyMeaningText: The Identity section lists the product manufacturer, when known. Information applies to the specific IAN.
companyMeaningExample: Available manuals are linked on product pages. A company operating a spare parts catalog may differ from the manufacturer.
ianBox: On the box: look for “IAN” in the product information or on the label.
ianProduct: On the product: check the rating plate or sticker, often underneath or on the back; it may also be engraved.
ianManual: In the manual: check the cover and the service or warranty section.
ianExample: An example format is IAN 407702_2207: copy the complete code, including the part after the underscore when present. Its location and format can vary between products.
ianVariantsTitle: Why we use it in the catalog
ianVariantsText: The same model name may appear with different IANs. Before using a record, match both model and IAN against your tool: specifications or a manufacturer verified for one IAN are not automatically assigned to another. The complete suffix is kept in the notes when available.
translationMissing: Some descriptions are available in English only.
translationReview: Updated descriptions are available in English.
variantIntro: IANs for this model. Each record retains its own documented specifications.
multipleModelsHint: This IAN lists multiple model codes: match the full code against your product.
multipleIansHint: Compare the IANs in the product page table.
scanPrivacy: The photo is read in your browser and is never sent to a server.
scanHint: Photograph one product to find similar items, or its label to read the IAN and model. Avoid glare and cluttered backgrounds.
scanCropHint: Swipe on the photo to scroll. Tap Crop to select a single product or label.
scanReady: Check the detected code: you can edit it before searching.
scanNoCode: No IAN or model found. Try a closer crop of the label or enter the code below.
scanSearchHint: Searching clears the other filters. IAN searches use the number before any suffix.
scanImageError: Could not open this image. Try a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
scanSizeError: The image is too large. Choose a photo smaller than 25 MB.
scanError: Could not read the label. Try again or enter the code manually.
scanTimeout: Reading is taking too long. Try a smaller crop.
scanManualHint: Choose a product or label photo. You can also enter an IAN or model directly.
scanVisualDownloadHint: On first use, the visual model and text reader download about 50 MB from this site. Photos and text are processed on your device, never uploaded or saved.
scanVisualDisclaimer: These are candidates to compare, not a confirmed identification. Check the label, model, IAN and specifications before choosing a record.
scanVisualCoverage: Comparing images from {count} records with photos. Text can also find products without photos.
scanHybridUseText: Also match text in the photo
scanHybridLoading: Comparing the image and reading text on your device…
scanHybridReady: Candidates ranked using both image and text. Check the detected clues before choosing a record.
scanHybridMultiple: The text contains codes for multiple products or details to compare. Crop one item with its description.
scanHybridTextUnavailable: Text could not be read: these candidates use only the image. You can retry with a clearer crop.
scanHybridImageUnavailable: Visual matching is unavailable: these candidates use only the detected text. Check the model and IAN.
scanVisualEnglish: The product name is available in English.
scanVisualDownloading: Loading the model onto your device: {percent}%
scanVisualReady: Here are the most similar products. Compare candidates or read the label to search for the exact code.
scanVisualWeak: The similarities are weak. This product may not be in the catalog: try a tighter crop or read the label.
scanVisualEmpty: No candidates available. Try reading the label or searching for an IAN or model.
scanVisualTimeout: Matching is taking too long. Try again or read the label instead.
scanVisualError: Visual search is unavailable on this device or could not load. You can retry, read the label or enter a code manually.
scanCropEditing: Drag on the photo to select an area. Release to scroll again.
scanCropSelected: Area selected. Scroll to search, or tap Crop to change the selection.
compareLimit: You can compare up to 3 products. Remove one to add another.
compareIntro: Choose up to 3 products from the catalog to compare their available specifications.
compareCopyFailed: Copy the link from the address bar.
compareNeedTwo: Add another product to see similarities and differences.
compareNotes: Incomplete rows remain visible with “Differences only”. Missing data does not mean a missing feature.
compareMixed: These products belong to different categories: some specifications may not be comparable.
compareInvalid: Some IANs in the link are not in the catalog.
compareNoDiff: No differences in the available data.
compareScroll: Scroll the table to the right to see all products.
compareLoadFailed: Unable to load the comparison. Reload the page to try again.
contributionIntroText: Find the records where you can add a missing detail.
missingCombinationHint: Show records missing only the selected details. Leave everything unchecked to see all incomplete records.
contributionEmptyText: Try another IAN or model, change the category or adjust the selected missing details.
